newsitem.title: OMAN: Shell Oman listing set for second-half July.
newsitem.headline: Shell Oman listing set for second-half July.

text.p: Forty percent of Shell Marketing Oman Ltd will be open for public subscription on the Muscat Securities Market (MSM) in the second half of July, MSM executive vice-president Ashraf Nabhan Al-Nabhany said on Monday.

Royal Dutch/Shell Group plans to divest a 51 percent stake in its wholly-owned marketing subsidiary in Oman led by a 40 percent float on the MSM with a further 11 percent reserved for existing Omani investors.
Oman's al-Watan newspaper quoted Nabhany as saying that four million shares worth 19.6 million rials would be on offer and that the firm expected to secure a 10.5 percent return in 1997/98.
Trading in the shares of Shell Marketing Oman Company SAOG would begin in September, a Shell spokesman has said.
The Anglo-Dutch oil group will maintain a 49 percent stake in the marketing firm which specialises in the retail sale of transport and aviation fuels in the Gulf Arab state.
